label.text: Negative balance transferable to later periods

working_figures.help: Negative results of this return and earlier returns of the year still to deduct in box 15 of a later quarter.
working_figures.editability_words: Cadrumo calculates it from other boxes.

label.text: Net income qualifying for the art. 32.1 reduction

working_figures.help: The part of the cumulative net income generated over more than two years or notoriously irregular, imputed in a single period. Leave it out if your activity regularly obtains such income. Box 03 is calculated after reducing it by 30%, on at most 300,000 euros a year.
working_figures.editability_words: Type the amount or value for this box.

label.text: Deductible expenses before the simplified-modality provision

working_figures.help: Deductible expenses and amortization from 1 January to the end of the quarter, without the deductible provisions and hard-to-justify expenses. Box 02 adds that provision to them.
working_figures.editability_words: It follows your records; correct it there and recalculate.

working_figures.help: Simplified direct estimation only: the percentage set by article 30 of the IRPF Regulation on your cumulative income less your deductible expenses, up to its annual limit. It is zero when that difference is negative.
working_figures.editability_words: Cadrumo calculates it from other boxes.

label.text: Negative results of this year's earlier quarters not yet deducted · box 15

answers.help: The amount, without sign, of the negative results of your earlier Form 130 returns for this year that you have not deducted before.
answers.editability_words: Carried from an earlier filing; you may replace it, and it shows as replaced until you restore the source.

label.text: Net income from economic activities in last year's income tax return · Form 100, boxes 0224, 1479, 1553 and 1577

answers.help: Box 13 reduces the payment only when this income was 12,000 euros or less. Give the sum of these boxes of your return for the previous year.
